title: Acme Cloud
text:
Acme Cloud

Acme Cloud is a managed hosting platform. These pages describe billing, plan limits and refunds.

Every account starts on the Free plan and can be upgraded at any time from the billing settings page.

title: Billing - Acme Cloud
text:
Billing

Acme Cloud bills monthly on the day of the month you subscribed. Invoices are issued in USD and are available under Settings, Billing, Invoices.

We accept Visa, Mastercard and American Express. Bank transfer is available on the Enterprise plan only, with net 30 payment terms.

If a payment fails we retry three times over seven days before the account is downgraded to the Free plan.

title: Plan limits - Acme Cloud
text:
Plan limits

The Free plan allows 3 projects and 1 GB of storage. The Pro plan allows 25 projects and 100 GB of storage. The Enterprise plan has no project limit.

Rate limits are 60 requests per minute on Free, 600 on Pro and 6000 on Enterprise. Exceeding the limit returns HTTP 429.

Storage overages are billed at 10 cents per gigabyte per month.

title: Refunds - Acme Cloud
text:
Refunds

Annual plans can be refunded within 30 days of purchase. Monthly plans are not refundable, but you can cancel at any time and keep access until the end of the billing period.

To request a refund, email support and include your invoice number. Refunds are processed within 5 business days to the original payment method.

title: Acme Refund Policy

Acme Refund Policy
